Durango is a septic hot spot (Durango Septic, Mountain Septic, LePew Four Corners, Alpenglow Gunnison). Durango Septic literally brands on answering the phone ("the last thing you want is a voicemail") with a small crew in the field. No scheduling software observed anywhere in the segment; software grades UNKNOWN across the board. Segment is nearly all phone-only (8 of 9); only San Juan Pump (Montrose) has an unblocked contact form, though it is a customer form with no B2B invitation.

September sits in the pre-freeze service window: well owners schedule pump checks and pressure-tank work before winter, and no-water emergencies are the segment's most perishable lead type, a caller with no water works down a list until someone answers.
